note: These are proposed properties, not verified Python-to-Dafny correspondences. No formal score is awarded until a reviewer approves a Dafny model and its relation to the Python task.

tasks.property: Evaluating a derived, reordered union queryset leaves the original union's records and order unchanged for later evaluation.
Related-field choices use ModelAdmin ordering when available and otherwise fall back to the related model's Meta ordering, without dropping eligible records.
Scalar assignment to an object array stores the original object even if that object has a values property.
A deep copy preserves Unicode index values and their dtype and does not alias mutable storage.
Quantile operations preserve attributes when keep_attrs is enabled.
Conditional selection preserves input attributes when attribute preservation is explicitly requested.
Swapping dimensions does not mutate the original object.
Data-variable enumeration remains correct even when coordinate names include names absent from the variable map.
Stacking preserves the dtype of an int32 coordinate.
Parsing an empty tuple annotation terminates without an index error and returns a valid representation.
